title: Guided vs Self-Guided Berlin Walking Tour - Quick Summary
items: **Choose the problem, not a winner.** A live guide gives you orientation and follow-up questions; a self-guided route gives you timing and pace control.
**For most first-time visitors, guided comes first.** Learn the shape of central Berlin, then use a focused self-guided route for one subject.
**Choose self-guided first when timing is uncertain.** It is the honest option for a late arrival, frequent pauses or a private pace.
**Do not repeat two broad highlight walks.** Let the first walk cover the city shape and the second answer one unfinished question.
BerlinWalk lasts about 2 hours through the historic centre of former East Berlin. It starts at the World Clock and does not follow the Berlin Wall line.
